name: in_court_rule
description: Full text of one Indiana statewide court rule by citation, e.g. Trial Rule 60 (set "trial", rule "60"), Appellate Rule 9, Evidence Rule 401, Criminal Rule 2.1, Professional Conduct 1.6. Returns the rule heading, effective date, text, and the published version history where one exists. Add a subdivision like "60(B)" to also get just that part. Source: Indiana Supreme Court, Indiana Rules of Court. Not the Indiana Code (use indiana-code) and not county local rules (use in_local_rules).

set.description: Rule set: trial, appellate, evidence, criminal, admission-discipline, prof-conduct, small-claims, judicial-conduct, admin, adr, jury, tax, records, and others. Common names like "trial rules" or "professional conduct" also work. See in_court_rules_list.

rule.description: Rule number as cited: "60", "60(B)", "4.1", "401", "1.6". Decimals use a dot.

name: in_court_rules_list
description: List the Indiana Rules of Court. With a set (e.g. "trial"), returns every rule in it with its number and title, so you can find the right citation. With no set, returns every rule set with its name and rule count. Source: Indiana Supreme Court, Indiana Rules of Court.

set.description: Rule set id or common name, e.g. "trial", "appellate", "evidence". Omit to list all sets.

name: in_local_rules
description: Text of an Indiana county's local court rules (circuit/superior court rules, district governance plan, city-court rules). Given a county (e.g. "Johnson"), returns the county's documents and the rule text: pass query for a keyword search across the county's rules ("motion practice", "bond", "court reporter"), rule for one citation as the county numbers it ("LR41-TR-102"), or neither to read the document from the start (paginate with offset). Covers 91 of 92 counties; a document with no machine-readable text, or a county with no published rules, says so and returns the document link rather than an empty answer. With no county, returns every county with its coverage. Every response carries data_as_of. Source: Indiana Supreme Court, Indiana Judicial Branch, local court rules by county.

county.description: Indiana county name, with or without "County", e.g. "Johnson", "St. Joseph". Omit to list counties and coverage.

query.description: Keywords to find in the county's local rules, e.g. "motion for continuance". Returns the best-matching passages.

rule.description: A rule citation as the county numbers it, e.g. "LR41-TR-102". Returns that rule's text.

document.description: 1-based document number from the documents list, to restrict to one document.

offset.description: Character offset when reading a document from the start.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of rule text to return (500-20000, default 6000).
